description: This file defines a Java interface representing a data structure with an ID and a date, likely used within the Fineract project for managing COB (Close of Business) data related to the last closed business date.

classes.name: COBIdAndLastClosedBusinessDate
classes.description: A Java interface for accessing COB ID and the last closed business date.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID associated with the COB data.

methods.name: getLastClosedBusinessDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the last closed business day.
